content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make chickpea and red bean salad, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Finely dice the red onions (5 minutes)
Step 2. Toss the salad in a large wooden bowl (2 minutes)
Step 3. Rinse the canned chickpeas under cold water (3 minutes)
Step 4. Whisk the balsamic vinegar and olive oil together (2 minutes)
Step 5. Slice the cherry tomatoes in half (6 minutes)
Step 6. Mince three cloves of garlic (4 minutes)
Step 7. Chop fresh parsley leaves (4 minutes)
Step 8. Drain the liquid from the red beans (2 minutes)
Step 9. Crumble the feta cheese over the mixture (3 minutes)
Step 10. Zest a fresh lemon (2 minutes)
Step 11. Measure out the dried oregano (30 seconds)
Step 12. Season with sea salt and cracked black pepper (1 minute)
Step 13. Combine chickpeas and beans in a mixing bowl (2 minutes)
Step 14. Prepare the base of the vinaigrette (3 minutes)
Step 15. Add a pinch of red pepper flakes (30 seconds)
Step 16. Dice the English cucumber (7 minutes)
Step 17. Garnish with the chopped parsley (1 minute)
Step 18. Measure out the red beans (1 minute)
Step 19. Wash all fresh vegetables (10 minutes)
Step 20. Peel the cucumber and onions (5 minutes)
Step 21. Grind the dried herbs (2 minutes)
Step 22. Sterilize the salad tongs (5 minutes)
Step 23. Retrieve all canned goods from the pantry (2 minutes)
Step 24. Clean the kitchen counter space (10 minutes)
Step 25. Rinse the red beans (3 minutes)
Step 26. Slice the stalks of celery (5 minutes)
Step 27. Peel the garlic cloves (2 minutes)
Step 28. Set out all the measuring cups and spoons (3 minutes)
Step 29. Clean the used cutting board (5 minutes)
Step 30. Pat the chickpeas dry with a paper towel (4 minutes)
Step 31. Pit and halve the kalamata olives (6 minutes)

Step 33. Squeeze the juice from the lemon (2 minutes)
Step 34. Sanitize the vegetable knife (3 minutes)
Step 35. Measure out the chickpeas (1 minute)
Step 36. Drain the chickpeas from their soaking liquid (2 minutes)
Step 37. Mix the dry seasoning blend (2 minutes)
Step 38. Slice the bell peppers into thin strips (8 minutes)
Step 39. Measure the Dijon mustard for the dressing (1 minute)
Step 40. Open the can of chickpeas (1 minute)
Step 41. Finely chop the fresh mint (5 minutes)
Step 42. Chill the salad bowl in the refrigerator (30 minutes)
Step 43. Gather the salad dressing ingredients (5 minutes)
Step 44. Sort through the fresh herbs (5 minutes)
Step 45. Emulsify the dressing by shaking it in a jar (2 minutes)
Step 46. Discard the red bean canning liquid (1 minute)
Step 47. Pick the mint leaves off the stems (4 minutes)
Step 48. Pour the dressing over the bean mixture (1 minute)
Step 49. Place the chopped vegetables in a separate tray (5 minutes)
Step 50. Dry the salad greens (5 minutes)
Step 51. Slice the red onions into rings (5 minutes)
Step 52. Arrange the salad on a serving platter (5 minutes)
Step 53. Mix all ingredients thoroughly (4 minutes)
Step 54. Wipe down the lemon before zesting (1 minute)
Step 55. Lightly toast the cumin seeds (3 minutes)
Step 56. Clear the dining table (10 minutes)
Step 57. Inspect the chickpeas for any debris (2 minutes)
Step 58. Open the can of red beans (1 minute)
Step 59. Sharpen the chef's knife (5 minutes)
Step 60. Locate the salad serving spoons (1 minute)
Step 61. Add the minced garlic to the salad (30 seconds)
Step 62. Top with a sprinkle of lemon zest (30 seconds)
Step 63. Soak the red onions in cold water to mellow them (10 minutes)
Step 64. Drain the chickpeas in a colander (2 minutes)
Step 65. Combine the vegetables with the beans (3 minutes)
Step 66. Add a final drizzle of extra virgin olive oil (30 seconds)
Step 67. Dice the sun-dried tomatoes (4 minutes)
Step 68. Toast the pine nuts for topping (5 minutes)
Step 69. Whisk in the lemon juice to the dressing (1 minute)
Step 70. Remove the plastic wrap from the produce (1 minute)
